milestones.title: Reached 12,000 men's ODI runs
milestones.description: Became the seventh batter and third Indian to reach 12,000 runs in men's ODIs.

milestones.title: Only batter with three men's ODI double centuries
milestones.description: Scored three ODI double centuries; his 264 against Sri Lanka remains the format's highest individual score.

milestones.title: Retired from Test cricket
milestones.description: BCCI confirmed his retirement from Test cricket and noted his continued availability for India's ODI campaigns at the time.

milestones.title: Retired from T20 Internationals
milestones.description: Announced his T20I retirement after India's 2024 Men's T20 World Cup final win.

note: Milestone wording and dates link to ICC/BCCI sources. Follow linked reports for source context.
